description:
Transcript.lol turns audio and video into accurate, speaker-labelled transcripts - meetings, customer calls, interviews, podcasts, lectures and more, in dozens of languages. This plugin gives ChatGPT OAuth-scoped access to your Transcript.lol workspaces so you can work with your recordings without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Find recordings by what was said: semantic or exact search across every transcript, with timestamps for each hit.
- Read transcripts and translations: full text, a specific time window, or SRT/VTT/JSON formats.
- Reuse or generate AI insights: pull summaries, action items and key points already generated, or run one of your workspace prompts to create a new insight.
- Start new work: submit a public audio/video URL for transcription, or request a translation into another language, then poll for completion.
- Keep your library organised: create and rename folders, move recordings, rename recordings, and label diarized speakers with named people.

Every tool runs under the connected user's own permissions: ChatGPT only sees the workspaces and recordings that account can already access. Requires a Transcript.lol plan with API access.

defaultPrompt: What were the action items from my last meeting?
Summarize yesterday's client call for me
Turn this YouTube video into notes I can skim
